clearancePolicy: Use only published signed road vertical clearances for vehicles (BCC Open Data road-restrictions, Queensland Rail SEQ low bridges, TMR/NHVR notices). If a crossing has no published road clearance (high open river spans), omit clearanceHeightM and set clearanceStatus to unknown. Pedestrian/cycle-only bridges are not_applicable. Never invent mock demo heights. Never treat Maritime Safety Queensland vessel air draft above HAT as a truck road clearance.
sources: Brisbane City Council Open Data — Road height restrictions (dataset road-restrictions), retrieved 2026-11-23: https://data.brisbane.qld.gov.au/explore/dataset/road-restrictions/
